procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220-800); the seven pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_90 (cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/amite/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (13/13; doubtful digits re-read at 800 dpi).
structure_note: The first three-column-group sheet: p1 is the certification/signature page (signed Nov 13); p2+p3 = table A's first two precinct column groups (11 columns each: Amite River/Ariel/Berwick/Crosby Public Library/East Centreville/East Fork/East Gloster/East Liberty/Gloster/Homochitto/Liberty, then New Zion/Oneil/Riceville/Smithdale/South Liberty/Street/Tangipahoa/Tickfaw/Vance Park/Walls/Zion Hill); p4 = table A's TAIL page carrying ONLY the printed TOTAL column (no precinct cells); p5+p6 = table B's two column groups; p7 = table B's TOTAL-only tail page. The SEMS row-block split: 'Chancery Court 4-Chancery District 04 Place 3' carries TWO candidates across the table A/table B boundary -- Halford's row and TOTAL complete table A and Ashunda Hampton's row starts p5 (the same section split Adams/Franklin/Jefferson/Wilkinson print, the fifth county). Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District (Ron Eller, Bennie G. Thompson, Bennie Foster -- the House 2 roster, names identical); Court Of Appeals 04-District 4 Position 2 (David McCarty -- the eighth county in the identical CoA 4 family); Chancery Court 4-Chancery District 04 Place 1 (E. Vincent Davis), Place 2 (Wayne Smith), Place 3 (Debbra K. Halford, Ashunda Hampton) -- the same Chancery 4 roster four counties print, names identical (fifth county, rosters now identical five counties over); Circuit Court 6-1-Circuit District 6-1 (Carmen Brooks Drake) and Place 2 (Debra W. Blackwell) -- the same Circuit 6 pairing Adams prints, names and X patterns its own (Drake's section X-marks Amite River/East Fork/East Liberty, Blackwell's marks East Fork? no -- Street; their coverage overlaps at East Gloster/Gloster). Printed totals: Colom 2142, Hyde-Smith 3025, Pinkins 92, Eller 3044, G. Thompson 2141, Foster 70, McCarty 4033, E. Vincent Davis 4012, Wayne Smith 4234, Halford 3246, Hampton 1699, Drake 1132, Blackwell 2989.
operator_rows_note: All 13 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (eleven precinct cells) + the p4 printed TOTAL; Hampton's, Drake's and Blackwell's rows carry p5 + p6 cells + the p7 printed TOTAL. The X-celled Circuit rows (Drake, Blackwell) supply only the numeric cells plus the printed TOTAL -- the X-marked blanks become 0 under the row's own printed TOTAL (Drake 948+184 = 1132; Blackwell 867+2122 = 2989), the established X-cell rule.
truncation_note: No truncations; the twenty-two precinct headers print complete ('Amite River', Ariel, Berwick, 'Crosby Public Library', East Centreville, East Fork, East Gloster, East Liberty, Gloster, Homochitto, Liberty, New Zion, Oneil, Riceville, Smithdale, South Liberty, Street, Tangipahoa, Tickfaw, 'Vance Park', Walls, Zion Hill).
local_note: p5/p6 end with the local 'School Board 5-School Board' section (Janice Jackson Cordova, X-celled in the p5 group with values in the p6 columns) -- local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. Chancery 4's three Places and Circuit 6's two Places print in-county, so the families write Place-qualified labels (matching the other Chancery 4 and Circuit 6 counties).
